title: Lithium — curated atomic gas supplement, 2026-10-06
body:
# Lithium — curated atomic gas supplement, 2026-10-06

Stage status: IMPLEMENTED. Actual terminal software/publication verification is recorded in the linked batch receipt. Full MAT scientific and image acceptance remains PARTIAL.

## Existing owners and reconciliation

MAT:0003 remains Lithium. The [unchanged master](../../records/0003-Lithium-Li/data/structured/0003-Lithium-Li.yaml) declares neutral MAT:0003:ATOM:Li at /states/0 and a separate BCC bulk phase. The atomic gas supplement does not replace the solid, isotopic, ion, molecular, battery or transport owners. The authored [table manifest](../../records/0003-Lithium-Li/data/structured/0003-Lithium-Li-Table-Manifest.yaml) and [graph manifest](../../records/0003-Lithium-Li/data/structured/0003-Lithium-Li-Graph-Manifest.yaml) retain their original LF prefixes and legacy identifiers. Reviewed table10/graph10 are additive; graph9 remains the authored theoretical-capacity calculation. Source036 melting/boiling and source040 representative transport data retain distinct scope.

## Primary source, range and evidence

The exact [NIST gas-only page](https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C7439932&Units=SI&Mask=1) identifies neutral Li, CAS7439-93-2 and InChI=1S/Li. One Chase (1998) GAS fit covers 1620.12–6000 K on mol Li basis; its comment reports June 1962 review. SRC-000510 is a new species-specific gas accession in the [existing source registry](../../data/registries/sources.yaml), distinct from Lithium isotope/bulk references. It is not an independent experimental replication. The [main snapshot](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-0003-2026-10-06.html.txt) and [exact JANAFG publisher snapshot](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-0003-2026-10-06-table.html.txt) preserve their original bytes and SHA-256 hashes. The [publisher table](https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C7439932&Units=SI&Mask=1&Type=JANAFG&Table=on) supplies 45 Cp/entropy/enthalpy-increment checks; all passed printed-precision comparisons. All 101 within-fit samples were finite and positive; numerical dH/dT and dS/dT checks passed.

The publisher prints its first temperature as 1620., which is nominally outside the fit. Its 1619.5–1620.5 K printed-temperature cell contains the exact source minimum 1620.12 K, where all three quantities match the printed outputs. The raw row and explicit calculation temperature remain in the [evaluation index](../../data/catalog/thermochemistry-evaluation-index.json), linked to the [retained publisher snapshot](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-0003-2026-10-06-table.html.txt). The per-record evaluation carries the explanatory review note and source links. This is a documented source-format resolution; it does not widen fit validity or establish physical uncertainty. No accepted sample evaluates this fit at 1620 K.

The source enthalpy increment retains H(T)-H(298.15 K); the supplied reference offset does not authorize evaluating the gas fit at 298.15 K or infer a solid-to-gas transition. No new boiling point, latent heat, equilibrium vapor fractions or phase diagram is calculated. A separately retrieved [condensed-phase page](https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C7439932&Units=SI&Mask=2) was reviewed only as a private diagnostic: its liquid/solid fits remain unaccepted and require explicit phase/state bindings and further review. Applied sample pressure, isotope proportions and coefficient uncertainty/covariance remain UNKNOWN. Molecular spin-isomer populations do not apply to the monatomic species. These are source/arithmetic checks, not new calorimetry or independent experimental replication.

## Implemented outputs and compatibility

The [thermal chapter](../../records/0003-Lithium-Li/0003-Lithium-Li-Thermochemistry.md), [structured evaluation](../../records/0003-Lithium-Li/data/structured/0003-Lithium-Li-NIST-Thermochemistry.yaml), [calculated table](../../records/0003-Lithium-Li/tables/0003-Lithium-Li-TABLE-010-Thermodynamic-Functions.md), [CSV](../../records/0003-Lithium-Li/tables/0003-Lithium-Li-TABLE-010-Thermodynamic-Functions.csv) and [SVG](../../records/0003-Lithium-Li/graphs/0003-Lithium-Li-GRAPH-010-Heat-Capacity.svg) share one retained source and exact species/units/range context. Existing subject, slot, asset receipt and numerical guards are reused. The extractor now rejects curated non-JANAFG comparisons and any mixed/condensed retained fit before publishing its catalogue; it never silently filters phases. Legacy all-phase owners retain their original behavior and outputs. Thirteen extraction tests passed, including 30 rejection cases preserving the prior temporary catalogue and actual retained H2/He equality.

The native preview passed actual visual inspection for complete labels, valid endpoint markers, source, molar basis and explicit unknown context. This is a supplemental scientific chart with zero standalone A/B panel credit.

## Verification and remaining work

The [batch receipt](../../data/quality/thermal-lithium-batch-2026-10-06.json) holds actual terminal tests, source/asset hashes, working-tree snapshots, migrations and preservation evidence. The baseline tests passed 19/19. Preservation checked 5,184 prior record files: 5,181 byte-identical and three complete authored prefixes retained; 37 previous fit owners/receipts, 71 gaps, 111 chart/data/CSV hashes and 401 source nodes remain unchanged. The curated Lithium master and all authored table/graph files are unchanged.

Global totals: 38 thermal fit owners, 137 fits, 13,837 calculated rows, 71 thermal source gaps and 266 elemental supplemental charts. All 119 canonical identities are represented. All 143 master tasks, 4,248 confirmed-domain reviews and 2,587 standalone confirmed-element A/B slots remain pending; no element is certified fully advanced. Individual atomic-child projection remains separately deferred. Broader source metadata/rights, documentation and scientific acceptance remain open in the [existing selector](../../data/research/mat-update-review.json) and [MAT TODO](../../data/quality/MAT-TODO.json).

## Next executable requirement

Audit authored Beryllium 0004 and its applicable primary thermochemical sources. Its neutral child is MAT:0004:ATOM:Be at /states/0; preserve the separate HCP bulk phase and compound-specific BeO references. Accept a gas-only supplement under the current contract, or first extend explicit applicable phase/state bindings for condensed fits. Existing tables occupy 001–008: table009 is first free and table010 is also free. Existing graphs occupy 001–009: GRAPH:009 is the pressure-phase map and graph010 is first free. For the thermal package, use reviewed asset_slots {table:10,graph:10} only after repeating physical and manifest collision checks. Preserve the master, both manifests and authored bytes. Then continue 0005–0012 individually. Universal atomic-child projection, 71 bounded thermal source gaps, transport/dynamics/domain acceptance, documentation/source metadata and remaining standalone images remain pending. Source/state/table/chart acceptance precedes illustrations; MAT remains PARTIAL.

sources.scope_note: Species-specific gas evaluation; distinct from the retained Lithium isotope, melting/boiling and representative bulk-transport sources. No existing equivalent WebBook gas accession found. Publisher calculations are not independent corroboration.
sources.scope: The exact publisher species is Li with InChI=1S/Li, not Li2, Li ions or an equilibrium vapor mixture. One mole of the source species is one mole of Li atoms. No molecular factor of two applies. The gas-only response supplies one fit for 1620.12–6000 K. A separate retained condensed-phase diagnostic contains two LIQUID fits and one SOLID fit. Those fits are not imported, relabelled, or bound to the neutral atomic GAS state. No gas evaluation below the source minimum 1620.12 K is justified. The retained source limits do not themselves establish a boiling point, a gas stability boundary or a pressure-dependent phase boundary. Existing Li-6/Li-7 records and atomic-weight intervals retain separate scope. No isotope-specific gas properties or numeric isotope abundances are inferred from this elemental fit or its listed molecular weight. The Shomate equations contain no pressure variable. Applied pressure, arbitrary-pressure EOS and phase diagrams are not inferred. Separate source entropy reference-pressure labels belong to those original data only. No Li/Li2 equilibrium fraction, dimer dissociation, ionisation fraction, charge-state mixture or molecular nuclear-spin population is calculated or assigned. Fit boundaries from separate phases and enthalpy reference offsets are retained as reported and are not a constructed phase-transition path or latent-heat calculation. Coefficient uncertainty and covariance are unreported. Printed-temperature cells, output rounding and numerical derivative residuals are source-format/software checks, not physical uncertainty. Independent transcription arithmetic against publisher values and positive samples within the fit do not establish experimental replication, new calorimetry, complete Lithium thermophysics or element completion.
